description: **Three webs.** Area under the share-lost curve for each removal order in the three webs, under the rule “all prey lost”. The thick bar on the random row is the 95% range of 1000 random orders, and a thin bar is the range over the 200 tie-breaks. A filled marker means the order is different from random (p < 0.05). Different from random: Gulf of Cadiz (most important prey first, lowest trophic level first and highest trophic level first); Angolan shelf (most connected first, highest betweenness first, most important prey first and lowest trophic level first); Mondego estuary (none).
